curse.sevencurses.framelock.desc: the pendulum hangs between one step and the next
curse.sevencurses.memory.desc: something keeps piling up inside your chest
curse.sevencurses.memory.effect: holds 25% of heap + churn thread -> periodic GC stutter
curse.sevencurses.gpu.desc: when the fire goes out, the picture goes first
curse.sevencurses.gpu.effect: 16 render glitches: textures, artifacts, blackout, fake TDR
curse.sevencurses.keyscramble.desc: your hands remember the road; the road has moved
curse.sevencurses.keyscramble.effect: all keys scrambled except ESC; bad bursts, then relief
curse.sevencurses.gamma.effect: gamma forced to 0 + black fog; the world goes near-black
curse.sevencurses.mouse.desc: you point east; it drifts west
curse.sevencurses.mouse.effect: the mouse freezes, or inverts entirely
curse.sevencurses.tps.desc: the world answers you half a beat late
curse.sevencurses.tps.effect: server sleeps 60~200ms per tick -> TPS falls to 4~8
item.sevencurses.seven_curses_ring.desc: It is cold, like a ring just lifted out of deep water.
item.sevencurses.seven_curses_ring.desc2: Whoever puts it on will hear glass cracking, far below.
item.sevencurses.seven_curses_ring.curse: Seven small lines are cut into the inner band:
item.sevencurses.seven_curses_ring.toolt: Once worn, the curses do not listen. Only a hand that makes something from nothing can take it off.
boon.sevencurses.framecap.desc: the swift are held back first
boon.sevencurses.framecap.effect: better GPU -> lower FPS cap (iGPU 240 / mid 59 / flagship 10)
boon.sevencurses.damage.desc: grip it too tightly and the arm goes slack
boon.sevencurses.damage.effect: more CPU cores -> less damage (2c x3.0, 8c x1.0, 16c x0.57)
boon.sevencurses.speed.desc: the further you see, the less you move
boon.sevencurses.speed.effect: larger render distance -> slower, live (4ch x1.47, 32ch x0.9)
boon.sevencurses.armor.desc: run too smoothly and the hide thins
boon.sevencurses.armor.effect: live FPS -> less armor; above 120fps it goes negative (60fps +7.5 / 120fps 0 / 144fps -3)
boon.sevencurses.xp.desc: the brighter the screen, the less is learned
boon.sevencurses.xp.effect: higher resolution -> less XP (1080p x1.0, 4K x0.4; floor 1280x720)
boon.sevencurses.humility.effect: every level weakens all boons (-3%/level, gone at 30)
boon.sevencurses.armor.short: higher FPS, less armor (120+ goes negative)
